scope: The twelve existing pending candidates, not an exhaustive wider search.
method: Follow official AI Board links to meeting 67904 and its downloads. Follow page 3 OEIL links to Parliament HTML entries and PDFs. Direct HTTP returned empty 202; normal Edge browsing recovered all nine PDFs. Check magic, SHA-256, covers and body samples. Keep catalogue, cover, approval and registration dates distinct. No admission rule changes.
